items.q: What makes Poseidon's Eden different from my local fish store?
a: We offer a wider selection than most local stores, delivered to your door. Every animal is held and checked by our team before it ships, and we're here to help long after your order arrives.

items.q: Are the reviews at Poseidon's Eden real and verified?
a: Yes. Reviews come only from customers who bought from us. We publish good and bad reviews, and we reply to every concern.

items.q: Do you sell captive-bred and aquacultured animals?
a: Yes. Look for the "Captive-Bred" or "Aquacultured" label on product pages. These animals adapt well to home tanks and reduce pressure on wild reefs.

items.q: What is the quarantine process at Poseidon's Eden?
a: Every fish goes through a minimum of two weeks of quarantine before sale. During that time it's medicated, moved to a clean system, and fed three times a day until it's eating well and tank-hardened. See the Our Quarantine Process tab for the full details.

items.q: What does WYSIWYG mean?
a: "What You See Is What You Get." The animal in the photo is the exact one you'll receive. Other listings show a typical example of the species.

items.q: What steps does Poseidon's Eden take to support ethical marine life practices?
a: We favor aquacultured and captive-bred stock, avoid species that rarely survive in aquariums, and only work with suppliers who don't use harmful collection methods.

items.q: What if the weather is extreme where I live?
a: We watch the weather on both ends. If it's too hot or cold, we may hold your order and contact you to pick a safer date.

items.q: How do I track my order?
a: You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships. You can also check your order status in your account.

items.q: Do you guarantee live arrival?
a: Yes. If an animal arrives dead, contact us within 24 hours of delivery with a clear photo of it in the unopened bag. We'll issue a store credit or replacement livestock.

items.q: Is there a guarantee after the animal arrives?
a: Yes. Fish and corals are covered by our 3-Day Guarantee.

items.q: What do I need to do to make a claim?
a: Be home on delivery day, open the box right away and follow our acclimation guide. Send the photo and your order number to poseidonseden@gmail.com.

items.q: Does Poseidon's Eden offer guidance for beginners?
a: Yes. Our team can help you pick hardy, beginner-friendly fish and check that they'll get along with your current tank mates. Message us at poseidonseden@gmail.com before you buy.

items.q: Which fish are reef safe?
a: Each product page shows whether a fish is reef safe, reef safe with caution, or not reef safe, plus its care level and minimum tank size.

items.q: Will this fish get along with my tank mates?
a: Each product page lists the fish's temperament. If you're unsure, send us your tank size and current stock at poseidonseden@gmail.com and we'll check compatibility before you buy.

items.q: What size tank do I need?
a: The minimum tank size is listed on every product page. Bigger is always safer, especially for active swimmers like tangs and wrasses.

items.q: Can you hold a fish for me?
a: Yes, we can hold a paid fish for up to 2 weeks while your tank is ready.

items.q: Why does Poseidon's Eden quarantine its fish?
a: At Poseidon's Eden, we believe your aquatic pets deserve a healthy, sustainable start. That's why we quarantine and medicate our fish before they reach you, so parasites and diseases don't find their way into your system. It's part of our commitment to responsible aquatic retail, and we know not every quarantine process is built the same.

items.q: What makes the Poseidon's Eden approach different?
a: Our thorough method targets a broad range of diseases, including some that treatments like TTM and hypo can miss. We know your aquarium is more than a hobby. It's a way of life, and we're here to protect it from avoidable risks.

items.q: What does the quarantine treatment involve?
a: Our quarantine uses a strong combination of copper, prazi, formalin and antibiotics to deal with even stubborn diseases. This helps clear common problems such as Ich, Velvet, Blackspot, Brooklynella, Flukes, Tapeworm, Uronema and Vibrio, which TTM and hypo may not fully treat.

items.q: How are the fish cared for during quarantine?
a: Fish are fed three times a day. They're then moved to a sterile system with UV for the rest of their stay.

items.q: Are some fish quarantined longer?
a: Yes. Tangs go through a stricter quarantine, and we keep any fish longer if it still shows symptoms.

items.q: How long is the quarantine period?
a: Two weeks is our minimum. You're welcome to quarantine further at home if you like, but since most of the work is already done, you can feel confident your fish from Poseidon's Eden arrive in great health.

items.q: Are your fish guaranteed 100% parasite-free?
a: No, we can't promise fish are completely parasite-free. We still recommend you quarantine new arrivals, though it should take much less time than usual. Fish that haven't been quarantined can carry parasites, which may sit dormant in your tank until a new, stressed fish is added. Corals and inverts can also bring in disease if they come from infected waters, and natural sea water will introduce parasites.

items.q: How soon can I add more fish to my tank?
a: Wait at least 2 weeks between additions, so your tank's filtration can catch up and your current fish stay calm.
